ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity contrast; approximately 65-70% high-intensity white pixels across the central lobes against 30-35% low-intensity black pixels localized at the perimeter and central notch interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black mass radiating from the median notch into the lower medial sections of both lobes; distinct isolated black cluster at the lower-central region of the right lobe; continuous black pigmentation bands along the entire trailing edge topography.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior angle measured at approximately 42 degrees with a deep vertical bounding box penetration relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern; characterized by high-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys; major rectangular-shaped indentation (tissue loss) on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating from the median notch and tapering to sharp distal tips; left lobe exhibits a more consistent arc than the irregular right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity circular white pixels (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) concentrated along the black trailing edges and heavily clustered on the distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle low-intensity vertical and diagonal linear streaks visible across the white high-intensity surface of the left lobe medial region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serrated indentation and apparent tissue loss on the right lobe trailing edge immediately adjacent to the median notch; numerous white circular scars (barnacle attachment sites) on all dark-pigmented perimeters.
